description: Authentic historical news catalysts and macroeconomic headlines for StocX crisis regimes.
purpose: Provides genuine news catalysts for Dhairya's Screener Agent and Dashboard CRO reporting.

headlines.title: Sensex crashes 3,934 points in worst single-day plunge; 45-minute circuit breaker triggered
headlines.impact: Market-wide liquidity freeze and rapid flight to defensive quality assets.

headlines.title: PM Narendra Modi announces 21-day nationwide lockdown over coronavirus
headlines.impact: Complete physical economic shutdown; acute pressure on cyclical and automotive manufacturing.

headlines.title: RBI cuts repo rate by 75 bps to 4.40%, announces 3-month moratorium on term loans
headlines.impact: Historic emergency monetary easing; major regulatory relief for Indian banking sector.

headlines.title: RBI cuts reverse repo rate by 25 bps to 3.75% to push banks to lend
headlines.impact: Disincentivizes banks from parking surplus liquidity with the central bank.

headlines.title: Exit polls predict landslide majority for ruling NDA; Sensex surges 2,507 points to record high
headlines.impact: Euphoric pre-results positioning across high-beta public sector undertakings and capital goods.

headlines.title: Sensex tanks 4,390 points, Nifty falls 5.9% as BJP falls short of solo majority in election results
headlines.impact: Violent liquidation of high-beta PSU banks; sharp defensive rotation into private banks and FMCG.

headlines.title: Nifty rebounds 736 points as key coalition partners endorse NDA government formation
headlines.impact: Political continuity confirmed; rapid recovery in broad market benchmark.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve signals aggressive rate hikes starting in March to tame multi-decade high inflation
headlines.impact: Sharp contraction in global tech multiples and growth equity valuations.

headlines.title: RBI shocks market with surprise 40 bps off-cycle repo rate hike; CRR raised by 50 bps
headlines.impact: First rate hike in nearly four years; yields jump across the Indian sovereign curve.

headlines.title: Nifty IT index plunges 30% from peak amid US recession fears and IT discretionary budget cuts
headlines.impact: Severe multi-quarter valuation derating for Indian tier-1 and tier-2 IT services exporters.

headlines.title: Black Monday on Dalal Street: Sensex plunges 1,408 points; trading halted for 1 hour
headlines.impact: First massive signs of global subprime credit contagion reaching Indian equity markets.

headlines.title: Lehman Brothers files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy; Merrill Lynch acquired by Bank of America
headlines.impact: Global counterparty trust collapses; complete international commercial paper freeze.

headlines.title: Sensex crashes below 9,000 as FIIs pull out Rs 47,000 crore in relentless margin call liquidation
headlines.impact: Massive foreign institutional outflows trigger sharp rupee depreciation.

headlines.title: Nifty touches 2,524 trough in severe liquidity squeeze; RBI slashes CRR and opens repo windows
headlines.impact: Terminal capitulation low of the 2008 crisis before systematic central bank stabilization.
